_comment: OpenClaw heartbeat entry: watch a folder and transcribe anything new on a schedule. Pair with examples/batch-transcribe.sh (idempotent: finished files are skipped via their transcripts/ output).
name: transcribe-watch-folder
on_failure: Exit 4 means the wallet or key spend cap needs attention; exit 5 is transient, retry next tick; exit 6 means raise the per-file budget in the command.
